cohort: The study included 1396 women who delivered in hospitals during a one-year period in India.
finding: Inadequate gestational weight gain was associated with higher preterm deliveries and fetal growth restriction, especially in underweight women, while excess gestational weight gain was linked to higher induction and cesarean delivery rates, particularly in obese women.
mod_finding: Excess gestational weight gain was associated with a significantly higher cesarean delivery rate, particularly in obese women.
